description: This is a Java class named TestSupportFactory in the package com.salesmanager.test.isolated. It provides helper methods to create and store test data objects such as Product, Category, Country, Currency, Language, MerchantStore, ProductType, Manufacturer, and associated entities. These methods are typically used in testing scenarios to generate sample data with randomized or specified attributes.

classes.name: TestSupportFactory
classes.description: A Spring component providing helper methods for creating and storing sample product, category, country, currency, language, merchant store, product type, and manufacturer entities for testing purposes.

methods.name: createAndStoreRandomProduct
methods.description: Creates a new Product with randomized attributes, adds descriptions, availability, and pricing, then persists it using the product service.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new Category with descriptions in multiple languages, optionally nested under a parent category.

methods.name: createCountry
methods.description: Creates a new Country entity with descriptive details.

methods.name: createCurrency
methods.description: Creates a Currency object supported in the system.

methods.name: createLanguage
methods.description: Creates a new Language object with specified language code.

methods.name: createMerchantStore
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MerchantStore entity with specified name, country, currency, and language.

methods.name: createProductType
methods.description: Creates a new ProductType with a general code.

methods.name: createRandomManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a Manufacturer with a randomized name and description for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getRandomString
methods.description: Helper method to select a random string from an array.
